corrections.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE cutout PNG gameplay sprite on a completely transparent alpha background, NOT black and NOT a dark background. It must be usable over any bright game background. Use Image 1 as a design reference only: a side-view quadruped wolf demon constructed from jagged charred wooden branches, orange ember fissures, glowing amber eye and four clawed feet, facing RIGHT. Compact full-body silhouette with tail and all paws inside a square canvas, 15% empty transparent margin. Detailed hard-edged pixel art matching the reference creature. IMPORTANT: Solid cutout creature only. No smoke, no fog, no colored aura, no outside glow, no lighting haze, no drop shadow, no gradient or other background effects anywhere. All space outside the physical body and between branches and legs must have alpha=0. Orange cracks must stay INSIDE body. One single pose, no labels or text.
